name: PandaApps

Same address via node-pair or one-time key import. 0.2.2 is a security and stability release, recommended for everyone. Fixes a crash-loop on launch: reinstalling restored the encrypted key store from backup, but the Keystore key that unlocks it is device-bound and is not restored, so the app died on every start — backup of that store is now disabled and an unreadable store is repaired instead of fatal. The confirm screen now shows the FULL recipient address instead of a shortened one, so address-poisoning (a lookalike address matching the first and last few characters) can no longer hide there, and recipients are checksum-verified. Node-derived keys are validated and the address is pinned: if your node ever derives a DIFFERENT address — a reset or restored-with-another-seed node — the wallet stops and tells you your funds are at the old address, instead of silently showing you an empty new wallet. Gas price and limit from the RPC are now bounded, so a bad endpoint cannot drain the balance as fees.

apps.name: KeyUses
apps.description: NEW SIGNING KEY: uninstall the old version before installing this one (Android refuses an in-place update when the signature changes; Minima apps must re-pair MINIMA_ID with the node afterwards). Audit your node's 64 keys for one-time-signature re-use. Minima signatures are stateful: each key must move to a fresh leaf every time it signs, and a seed re-sync that set keyuses too low makes the node re-use a leaf it already spent on-chain, which weakens that key. KeyUses compares what the chain proves each key has signed against your node's own counter, flags any key at risk or with confirmed re-use, and gives you the safe keyuses value for your next re-sync. Read-only: it never builds a transaction. Your 64 public keys are sent to the archive audit service to look up spend history — public keys cannot move funds, but they do reveal your addresses to that server.

apps.name: Brain Wallet
apps.description: NEW SIGNING KEY: uninstall the old version before installing this one (Android refuses an in-place update when the signature changes; Minima apps must re-pair MINIMA_ID with the node afterwards). Derive a Bitcoin, Litecoin or Ethereum wallet from a passphrase and salt — nothing is stored, nothing is transmitted, and the app asks for no permissions at all. Two derivation schemes. scrypt (N=2^18) reproduces legacy 1... addresses byte-for-byte with the Brain Wallet MiniDapp 1.0.14, so a wallet made there comes back identically here; this is the default. Argon2id (384MB, 25 iterations) produces native SegWit bc1q.../ltc1q... addresses and Ethereum, matching brainwallet.io v3.0.1 — verified against vectors generated from that site's own code, with a native ARM build of the reference Argon2 so it takes ~8 seconds instead of ~75. Address and private key shown as text and QR. ⚠️ A brain wallet has NO checksum and NO recovery: one wrong character silently derives a different, perfectly valid wallet that is not yours. Verify recovery on a second device before funding, and store the passphrase and salt as exact byte-for-byte artifacts.

Each face = SHA3(node random ++ device SecureRandom) rejection-sampled to exact uniformity; maths locked bit-for-bit to iancoleman/bip39 by fixed vectors. Collections damaged by the old duplicate-seal bug are labeled honestly instead of retry-looping forever. v0.5.2: FILTR on phones — the image stays pinned on top while the editing panes (Import / Presets / Effects / Tune / Adjust / Post FX / Annotate / Save) flick one at a time from a bottom tab bar; no more scrolling the picture out of view. Desktop/tablet keeps the full three-column editor. v0.5.1: the mint gate fits before it refuses — icons auto-slim against your real collection details, so signed mints go through instead of near-miss refusals. v0.5.0: ALWAYS SIGNED — every mint carries the creator's signature (provable authorship in any wallet), and content is sized automatically before minting so nothing can ever seal-but-not-send; budgets now stand on an on-chain-proven transfer ceiling. v0.4.17: CRITICAL mint fix — item numbers could be sealed onto more than one coin (the same photo/plate number issued twice), which then deadlocked stamping with 'Waiting for blank unit coins'. Item numbers are now claimed before the transaction is sent, so a number can never be issued twice. Plus mint recovery (v0.4.16): a Recover button and an automatic watchdog. v0.4.16: MINT RECOVERY — a 'Recover mint' button on any unfinished collection re-reads the chain and puts the mint back on the right step (it posts nothing, it just re-syncs), plus an automatic watchdog that does the same when a mint stops progressing. Stalled mints now report what the engine actually sees instead of a bare 'waiting' message. v0.4.15: FIX — mints could stall forever at 'Waiting for blank unit coins' when dropped split transactions rewound the chain after the engine had moved on to stamping. The engine now returns to SPLIT and finishes the job; stuck collections self-heal on the first block after updating. v0.4.14: FIX — Painted plates were silently missing from photo collections (the AI painting compressed past every ladder rung after the transfer-budget tightening). The ladder now has a guaranteed floor, the photo pack seals only its rarity-axis traits on-chain, and the painting ships at 208-256px inside the safe transfer budget. On-chain end-to-end encrypted mail — no server, no Maxima, no internet permission. Identity from your node seed; every message is a sealed blob in a tiny coin. v0.5.1: FUNDS/KEY SAFETY on top of the 0.5.0 email makeover. Every send (message coins and payments) is now pinned to a signable wallet coin, so anyone-can-spend beacon dust on a shared node can't be grabbed and fail the send after it has already burned a WOTS key-use.
